integrity: The analytic proof uses the support-function semidefinite criterion and area/volume identities. The symbolic verifier checks algebra and does not certify broader or infinite-dimensional claims. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for the unit-width-normalized axial degree-three harmonic family in R3; neither the brightness 16/15 ratio nor the projection-body volume endpoint holds as a claim for arbitrary constant-width bodies. The random-deficit normalization excludes t=0. Unindexed equivalent results are possible and one relevant 92-page random-brightness source was unavailable for full-text inspection.
title: Exact projection-body volume and random-brightness law for axial cubic bodies
